subject: Renewal + midterm accelerator: proposal and co-term options
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Chu <evan.chu@neurolytics.ai>, Sarah Miles <sarah.miles@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + midterm accelerator: proposal and co-term options

Evan / Sarah —

Following our renewal cadence, attached is a refreshed proposal that combines the upcoming 12‑month renewal with a midterm uplift accelerator to cover the additional capacity you forecasted for Q3. The key options are:

- Option A (Conservative): 12‑month renewal, 15% volume discount, flexible monthly true‑up.
- Option B (Accelerator): 9‑month co‑term with a 25% committed uplift (applied as reserved units) and an 18% blended discount (implementation fee waived).
- Option C (Enterprise): 12‑month + 6‑month bridge credits, 12% discount, priority support SLA.

I pulled margins so we can be flexible on an accelerator if you can sign a co‑term and commit to the uplift by end of month. The attached PDF shows unit economics and a sample invoice schedule.

Ask: can you confirm which option aligns with your procurement timeline and whether Aisha (CFO) will need a separate quote for OPEX vs CAPEX treatment?

If it helps, we can schedule a 30‑minute call Monday to walk the numbers and legal can prepare a short amendment.

Thanks —
Priyom
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: [Renewal-Proposal-Neurolytics-v3.pdf]

--
Priyom Das
Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0219
From: Evan Chu <evan.chu@neurolytics.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Miles <sarah.miles@neurolytics.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + midterm accelerator: proposal and co-term options

Priyom —

Thanks for sending. We appreciate the options, but a few quick points from product and finance: 

1) We strongly prefer a 12‑month term (predictability for budgets).
2) The uplift % in Option B is higher than we can commit to today — we were hoping for a 15% uplift with a steeper discount (25% off list) because our usage will be seasonal.
3) Implementation fee waiver is attractive — can that be extended to include a one‑time migration support credit?

We need to get this wrapped by April 30 for our internal renewal calendar. I can bring Aisha in if we get closer on numbers. Can you do 25% discount for a 12‑month renewal with a 15% uplift reserved bucket?

—Evan
Head of Platform, Neurolytics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal + midterm accelerator: proposal and co-term options (internal)

Quick internal — Evan is pushing for a 25% list discount on a 12m term with only 15% uplift. That would put margin below target unless we tighten something else (SLA, support, or commit mechanics). Options I see: 

- Concede to 20% off list for 12m + 15% uplift reserved with a 60‑day implementation credit (we still keep margin).
- Offer 25% off but require a 20% prepayment or annual prepay (not likely palatable to them).
- Keep 18% but add a usage-based kicker: if uplift >25% we retro‑rebate to 22% (protects us).

Lauren — can you run finance on an 18% vs 20% blended for 12m with 15% uplift? Need quick numbers to present in the counter. Monica, flag legal for a short amendment template with the retro‑rebate clause.

-ben
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Chu <evan.chu@neurolytics.ai>, Sarah Miles <sarah.miles@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + midterm accelerator: proposal and co-term options

Evan —

Appreciate the clarity. We want to keep this simple for your procurement timeline (end of month). Here’s a clean counter that balances your ask and internal constraints: 

- 12‑month renewal (co‑term)
- 20% off list price (blended across token and support fees)
- 15% reserved uplift bucket for Q3, with monthly true‑up against usage
- No implementation fee and a one‑time migration support credit of 8 hours (applied to onboarding services)
- If uplift usage exceeds 25% of baseline during any month, we will apply a retro‑active rebate to increase total discount to 22% for that month (protects your seasonality, protects our unit economics).

I’ve attached a short draft amendment with the language and an invoice schedule. If that looks good, we’ll get legal and finance to fast‑track the quote and a DocuSign link. If Aisha wants a CAPEX‑style quote, we can generate a separate export.

Would you be available for a 20 minute call Wednesday to confirm signoff?

Priyom
attachments: [Amendment-Neurolytics-accelerator-draft.docx]
From: Sarah Miles <sarah.miles@neurolytics.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Chu <evan.chu@neurolytics.ai>, Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@neurolytics.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + midterm accelerator: proposal and co-term options

Priyom —

Thanks for the counter. This is much closer to what we need. Two quick asks before we send to finance: 

1) Can you confirm the monthly invoice cadence and whether the reserved uplift can be drawn down within a quarter (we expect spikes in July)?
2) Aisha — from a procurement POV, will the 20% blended discount plus your migration credit meet internal approval if we get a short amendment?

We should be able to finalize after a quick call — Evan and I are available Thursday 9–11 PT.

—Sarah
Director, Product Ops, Neurolytics
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Miles <sarah.miles@neurolytics.ai>, Evan Chu <evan.chu@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + midterm accelerator: proposal and co-term options

Sarah / Evan —

Confirming: monthly invoices (net 30) with reserved uplift drawdown allowed within the quarter (unused reserved units expire at quarter end but can be true‑upped into the next quarter at a discounted top‑up rate). I’ve asked legal to add a short clause for drawdown flexibility and to make the rebate language explicit.

We’ve queued a DocuSign for the amendment (Ben / Monica will finalize legal redlines on our side). I’ll send the link as soon as it’s ready. Targeting signature by Friday 4/23 to make your procurement window.

Thanks —
Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@neurolytics.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Sarah Miles <sarah.miles@neurolytics.ai>, Evan Chu <evan.chu@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + midterm accelerator: proposal and co-term options

Folks —

Reviewed the counter internally. The 20% blended discount + 15% reserved uplift with the migration credit looks acceptable to finance pending the final amendment language clarifying: (a) monthly invoice schedule, (b) reserved unit expiration and top‑up rate, and (c) the rebate calculation trigger (explicit threshold).

I will approve on the condition that the DocuSign includes the amendment and a one‑page summary for procurement. Evan / Sarah — once you send the DocuSign I will route internally and should be able to sign within 48 hours.

Aisha Kapoor
CFO, Neurolytics
